node_definition.done_when: A run whose worker has exited, whose worktree head has commits beyond its base, and whose manifest reads status: in-progress classifies as a recognised state named exited-unfinished, not blocked or unreadable. A new verb, `reckon crew repair-status --run RUN --status STATUS --reason TEXT`, rewrites that manifest's status line to complete, blocked or failed. It keeps the as-delivered manifest beside it as manifest.md.asdelivered and records the reason in the run directory. reckon/hooks/worker_stop.py accepts a manifest whose status is waiting with a well-formed wait block. Each of these has a test in tests/test_run_state_reads_what_the_worker_reached.py that fails at the base. The tests use temporary run directories and a temporary config home, never the real ~/.config/reckon. The section's third defect, a wait reported beside an audit finding, and the classification of a status word outside reckon/crew/reports.py's in-progress set are not part of this node, because reports.py is claimed by another live run. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: Give a finished run that kept an unfinished status word a state of its own, and let a worker declare a wait, as the first two defects of crew-observability-truth §26 describe.
